Subject: algebraic geometry | ID: 42367

Consider the parabolic equation on a topological space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Step 3. The Fredholm operator \(V_{01300013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01300013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the real convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
